RULES_PAGE.TITLE: Game rules
RULES_PAGE.LANDING_NOTICE: For ages 18 and over only. Winning is not guaranteed.
RULES_PAGE.INTRO: These rules apply to every raffle on Tinguilin (tinguilin.yaba-in.com). By creating an account or taking part, you accept them.

SECTIONS.title: Who can take part
items: Participation is reserved for people aged 18 or over. You must confirm your age before any purchase or free ticket.
Each player uses a single personal account with accurate information.
In case of fraud, identity theft or abuse, Tinguilin may suspend the account and cancel its entries.

SECTIONS.title: Raffles
items: Each raffle page shows the prize, the ticket price in FCFA, the total number of tickets, the end date and its specific rules.
Tickets are on sale until the end date, or until every ticket is sold.
The ticket price is shown before payment and does not change during your purchase.

SECTIONS.title: Buying a ticket
items: Payment is made with Orange Money or MTN Mobile Money, through our payment provider.
Your tickets are created only once the operator confirms the payment. You then receive a notification.
A player can buy at most 200 tickets per raffle.
After several failed payments, purchases may be temporarily blocked.
A ticket is personal: it cannot be exchanged, transferred or resold. If Tinguilin cancels a raffle, paid tickets are refunded.

SECTIONS.title: Free tickets
items: Referral: your referee gets 1 free ticket on their first paid purchase, and you get 1 free ticket for every 5 referees who made a paid purchase.
Loyalty: you get 1 free ticket for every 10 raffles you entered with a paid ticket.
A free ticket gives exactly the same chances as a paid one. It cannot be converted into money.

SECTIONS.title: The draw
items: The draw runs automatically at the raffle end date, even if not every ticket is sold. A raffle with no tickets ends without a winner.
There is one winner per raffle. Each valid ticket is one chance: more tickets mean more chances, never certainty.
The draw is verifiable: a secret fingerprint is fixed before the first ticket is sold and revealed after the draw. Anyone can recompute the result from the Winners page.

SECTIONS.title: Winning and collecting the prize
items: The winner is notified in the app and by email.
They receive a 6-digit pickup code, shown on the winning ticket and sent by email. This code is personal: never share it.
The prize is handed over in person. The winner shows the code to a Tinguilin team member, who checks it. The code works only once.
The place and date of the handover are agreed with the winner by the Tinguilin team.
The prize cannot be exchanged or converted into money.

SECTIONS.title: Publishing winners
items: After validation, the winner’s name, profile photo and prize may be shown on the Winners page, with a photo of the handover.
You can hide your activity from the live feed in Responsible play.

SECTIONS.title: Playing responsibly
items: Taking part involves a risk of loss: winning is never guaranteed. Only play with money you can afford to lose.
You can set a spending limit per day, week or month. Lowering it applies immediately; raising or removing it applies after 24 hours.
If playing becomes a problem, take a break and talk to someone you trust.

SECTIONS.title: Personal data
items: We use your name, email, phone number, region, tickets and payments to manage your account, payments, draws, prize handovers and notifications.
You can choose which notifications you receive from your profile.
For any request about your data, contact support.

SECTIONS.title: Changes and contact
items: Tinguilin may update these rules. The current version is always shown on this page. A raffle in progress stays subject to the rules shown when you bought your ticket.
For any question or complaint, contact support from the app.
